scope: Physical equations underlying inspected first-party kernels and selected consumed vendor routines; not certification of every external package or survey inference.

findings.problem: efunc with model=qbins fell through to an unrelated dark-energy parameterization.
findings.correction: Continuous piecewise E obtained by integrating (1+q)dln(1+z).
findings.historical_result_impact: Existing qbins distance path did not call this unsupported expansion-rate branch. No cosmology refit claimed.

findings.problem: Binned comoving distance silently saturated above last bin; q and distance then disagreed.
findings.correction: Explicit NumPy domain errors, JIT-compatible invalid JAX output, and pre-sampler data validation.
findings.historical_result_impact: Inspected saved real/synthetic redshifts are inside existing domains; in-domain physical model unchanged.

findings.problem: Nonzero throughput outside spectral support was silently dropped from source flux while full reference normalization remained.
findings.correction: Reject evaluation of incomplete bands and retain inclusive model boundary; unused filters may still be prepared.
findings.historical_result_impact: 12 saved reference objects / 528 epochs are bitwise unchanged.

findings.problem: Uniform-slab attenuation evaluated zero divided by zero in the transparent limit.
findings.correction: Exact zero attenuation, stable thin-limit series and physical-domain rejection.
findings.historical_result_impact: Old positive-depth experiment grid is bitwise unchanged; historical outputs preserved.

findings.problem: Earlier acceleration shorthand did not specify energy versus mass density or c=1.
findings.correction: Explicit epsilon+3p, or rho+3p/c^2, with cosmological constant counted once.

findings.finding: Extrapolated low-RV historical and spline laws produce negative extinction for positive input dust, inconsistent with a passive screen.
findings.required_next_test: Adopt supported nonnegative extinction family and justified dust population, then regenerate/refit matched light curves, selection and bias corrections; compare held-out observables.
findings.not_established: Observed dust distribution, selected-sample fraction affected, distance bias or cosmological parameter shift. No arbitrary clamp or population truncation installed.

findings.finding: F99 normalization parameter AV is not exactly monochromatic A5495 or necessarily the SN broadband AV. Current source comment is inaccurate.
findings.required_next_test: Use explicit curve normalization and integrate actual spectra/passbands before interpreting broad-band ratios. Renormalization would be a changed model.

findings.finding: Active luminosity model is a trained SALT basis, not an ejecta energy-generation/deposition/transport calculation.
findings.required_next_test: Connect physically varied ejecta/abundances to time-resolved spectra, apply survey observation and selection, refit and test remaining standardized luminosity drift.

findings.finding: 703 of 27511 sampled native SALT grid nodes permit a negative M0+x1 M1 for at least one x1 in [-3,3].
findings.required_next_test: Trace actual fitted parameters, interpolation, phase and passband weights; test a validated alternative before changing learned surfaces.
findings.not_established: 703 affected observations or a negative integrated flux in any actual fitted epoch.

findings.finding: SALT colour equals physical reddening and beta equals RV+1 only under additional mapping assumptions, not in general.
findings.required_next_test: Physical SED extinction followed by the actual observer/filter/fitting chain; independent multiband or spectral information.

findings.finding: Host age, progenitor delay and selected mean luminosity are different estimands; a local slope times a median cosmic age is not generally the mean physical correction.
findings.required_next_test: Consistent host SFH/age definitions, latent delay distributions, selection and transport across redshift; propagate residual correction after existing standardization.

findings.finding: Accurate distance integration does not establish flatness, GR matter dynamics, CPL, no luminosity drift or a valid high-redshift Taylor expansion.
findings.required_next_test: Prespecified geometry/evolution alternatives constrained by common observations and independent probes.

findings.finding: Raw photon counting does not establish Gaussian independent extracted fluxes; shared uncertainty and selection need their own calibrated models.
findings.required_next_test: Image/flux recovery, shared-noise diagnostics and end-to-end selection/bias recalibration; avoid duplicate covariance contributions.

findings.finding: Local BAO ratios and imported CMB chains do not independently solve early-universe perturbations, recombination or instrument/map likelihoods.
findings.required_next_test: Separate complete early-universe/likelihood reproduction if those external physical assumptions are to be audited beyond the documented boundary.

path_scope: Implementation and evidence paths refer to the historical source snapshot, not current execution paths.
